The deeper tension is therefore simple but hard. Repetition deepens skill when it keeps renewing attention to consequence, when it speeds up recognition of the move that changes the rest, and when it stays willing to choose differently as conditions change. Repetition becomes empty routine when familiarity quietly becomes the decision rule, when the question is performed rather than used, or when the structure of the habit is mistaken for the success of the habit.
